name: Punjab Khalistan Arc / Third Front Doctrine
description: ISI's sustained effort to reactivate Khalistani militancy in Indian Punjab as 'third front' against India (complementing Kashmir and conventional threats). Post-1990s iteration emphasizes narcotics-funded operations, diaspora coordination, and social media radicalization rather than mass insurgency.

phase_1_1980s.name: Original Khalistan Insurgency
phase_1_1980s.characteristics: Mass militancy, Golden Temple occupation (1984), state-level armed confrontation
phase_1_1980s.outcome: Indian military/police suppression; costly victory; 20,000+ deaths

phase_2_1990s_2000s.name: Diaspora Preservation
phase_2_1990s_2000s.characteristics: Militancy suppressed in India but sustained in Pakistan (residual camps) and Western diaspora (Canada, UK, US)
phase_2_1990s_2000s.is_role: Pakistan maintained 'Khalistan' as pressure option; low-level cross-border infiltration

phase_3_2010s_present.name: Narco-Jihad Hybrid
phase_3_2010s_present.characteristics: Opioid crisis creates recruitment pool; social media enables coordination; targeted killings replace mass actions
phase_3_2010s_present.is_innovation: Financial self-sustaining operations through drug trade; deniable 'criminal' veneer

india_coordination: Amarjit Singh Brar tier — cross-border facilitators

recruitment_pool.demographic: Rural Punjab youth; unemployed/underemployed; opioid addicts
recruitment_pool.ideological_vector: Historical grievances (1984, Blue Star), farmer protests (2020-2021), identity politics

tactics: Targeted assassinations of Hindu leaders, police, informants

harmeet_singh_happy_phd.background: PhD credential (hence moniker) turned militant; represents educated leadership vs earlier peasant-army
harmeet_singh_happy_phd.is_support: Protected, funded, armed by ISI; coordinates with D-Company logistics

wadhawa_singh.status: Reported killed 2021 but succession sustained operations

lakhbir_singh_landa.role: Factional rival to Happy PhD; indicates fragmented leadership
lakhbir_singh_landa.significance: Multiple competing centers suggest ISI 'portfolio approach' — multiple horses

indian_response.effectiveness: Contingent — operations suppressed but not eliminated; recurring low-level attacks indicate sustained capability

film_relevance.dhurandhar_2_subplot: Primary secondary arc — Rizwan Shah's mission includes penetrating/ disrupting this network
film_relevance.narrative_stakes: Demonstrates multi-front threat India faces; connects Karachi criminal networks to Punjab security; justifies 'Naya Bharat' proactive doctrine
film_relevance.thematic_function: Continuity of threat — old enemies adapt; requires adaptive response

oracle_implications.rizwan_objective: Disrupt narco-jihad corridor; neutralize or turn key facilitators; gather actionable intelligence for Indian follow-on
oracle_implications.critical_path_insight: Local Punjab police coordination (Prabhneet Singh tier) is force multiplier; cross-border action alone insufficient
oracle_implications.voi_priority: Intelligence on 'Happy PhD' location and communications; diaspora financial flows; local recruitment networks
